factual_claims.source_evidence: Dividend policy section: 'On May 6, 2025, Coop Pank paid a dividend of 0.07 euros (net) per share from the profit earned in 2024, in the total net amount of 7,209 thousand euros.'

numerical_claims.claim: Net profit of 28.7 million euros in 2025 vs. 32.2 million euros in 2024 represents an 11% decrease.
numerical_claims.label: CORRECT
numerical_claims.source_evidence: Consolidated Statement of Profit or Loss and Other Comprehensive Income table

numerical_claims.claim: Net interest income decreased to 73.3 million euros in 2025 from 77.6 million euros in 2024.
numerical_claims.label: CORRECT
numerical_claims.source_evidence: Consolidated Statement of Profit or Loss and Other Comprehensive Income table

numerical_claims.claim: Total net operating income was 79.4 million euros in 2025 vs. 81.9 million euros in 2024; net fee and commission income was 4.5 million euros in 2025 vs. 4.3 million euros in 2024.
numerical_claims.candidate_value: 79.4 million EUR (2025) vs. 81.9 million EUR (2024); 4.5 million EUR (2025) vs. 4.3 million EUR (2024)
numerical_claims.label: CORRECT
numerical_claims.source_value: 79.4 million EUR (2025), 81.9 million EUR (2024); 4.5 million EUR (2025), 4.3 million EUR (2024)
numerical_claims.source_evidence: Consolidated Statement of Profit or Loss and Other Comprehensive Income table

numerical_claims.claim: Operating expenses were 41.5 million euros in 2025 vs. 40.6 million euros in 2024; cost-to-income ratio was 52.3% in 2025 vs. 49.6% in 2024.
numerical_claims.label: CORRECT
numerical_claims.source_evidence: Consolidated Statement of Profit or Loss and Other Comprehensive Income table and Ratios table

numerical_claims.claim: Credit loss allowances were 3.3 million euros in 2025 vs. 4.6 million euros in 2024; income tax expense was 5.8 million euros in 2025 vs. 4.5 million euros in 2024.

numerical_claims.label: CORRECT

numerical_claims.label: CORRECT
